Professional Experience & Qualifications sets required defaults; Preferred Qualifications makes its items nice_to_have. The closing invitation to apply without every qualification does not change those labels.
Generic workflow orchestration is left unmapped rather than equated with LLM orchestration; the preferred agentic orchestration frameworks explicitly support llm-orchestration.
The framework examples form one alternative group. The model platforms are joined by 'and' and are not grouped.
Interpreted 'observable' production as an observability requirement; flagged this lexical mapping for review. It overrides the preferred observability mention.
AWS CDK, Terraform, evaluation frameworks, and other technologies mentioned only in responsibilities are not independently labeled from those mentions; evaluation is supported separately by Preferred Qualifications.
Scientific domain knowledge, communication, collaboration, leadership, and mentoring are excluded as non-skills under this guide.
